question.text: Coolant used in car radiator is aqueous solution of ethylene glycol. In order to prevent the solution from freezing at $-0.3^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. How much ethylene glycol must be added to $5 \mathrm{~kg}$ of water ? $\left(\mathrm{K}_{\mathrm{f}}=1.86 \mathrm{~K} \mathrm{Kg} \mathrm{mol}^{-1}\right)$
